findings.text: follow-on: review-plan --dry-run still calls _review_dispatch_fields, which creates the report directory and writes brief.md, plan.html and plan-review.json before the dry_run guard is reached, so a preview that must not act leaves composition artifacts on disk; a distinct run id is minted per call so repeated previews accumulate report directories that store_delivered_report never consumes.

item_verdicts.diff: read eaffcf874 and 789867093 against 357025eac; +893/-71 across the four product files and the new test file — recovery.py generalises the composer to a plan subject, cli.py adds one subcommand, mcp.py one view, flight.py one validated read-only key.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's done_when names the composer fields, the sweep eligibility (quiet past the settle window, unreviewed at its fingerprint, no delivered-unstored report, at most one in flight), the dry-run resolution, the refused empty decline and the MCP view; tests/test_review_plan_command.py adds a case for each and the manifest records head 191 passed / base 172 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node composes a plan review — node id plan-review-of-<slug>, role review, a brief built from the plan-design rubric plus the plan path and repository roots, a sidecar naming plan_slug, plan_version, reviewed_blob_sha, plan_fingerprint and rubric, and a per-run report directory as the write path — dispatches it through the shared composer, sweeps quiet unreviewed active/draft plans, and exposes one crew review-plan subcommand and one MCP plan-review view; reckon/crew/recovery.py:438 plan_review_subject and the plan branch at reckon/crew/recovery.py:516 carry it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, base 357025eac to head 789867093, changed_paths match the grant, negative_control_log present and red (1 failed EXIT=1), baseline_suite and after_suite both present with failure_count 0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node is fenced to reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/cli.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/flight.py and tests/test_review_plan_command.py; the diff touches exactly those five files and no plan or evidence-fragment file.

justifications.durability: tests/test_review_plan_command.py:159 reddens on the sweep's ignored stored-review lookup under the recorded negative control, and :414 forces a live metadata edit so the sidecar provenance assertion compares against an independently computed git hash; docked because several cases assert passed-in wiring (session, local) rather than a code-independent property.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed manifest's head-gate.log and baseline.log are both on disk with headers naming revision, tree and command, and their 191/172 passed with 0 FAILED lines yield added_failure_count 0; docked because the two arms use two different basetemp paths and the base arm omits the new test file, so the head/base delta is a count of added tests rather than a common-set comparison.
justifications.fit: the change extends the existing composer, store and review store rather than adding a module, and names mechanisms (plan_review_subject, plan_review_settle_seconds, plan-review-of-) with no plan label; reckon/crew/flight.py:684 is the one new read.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:438 plan_review_subject and the plan branch of _review_dispatch_fields compose the declared brief, sidecar and report directory, and reckon/cli.py:2530 adds the one review-plan subcommand.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches exactly reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/cli.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/flight.py and tests/test_review_plan_command.py, the declared write paths, and edits no plan state or evidence fragment.
